name: Sakisaka Ryou
source:
Ryouka's son, a cute boy. A first-year student who works hard at soccer club practice. He's loved bathing with Mom since childhood, but as he grew, his love for mother crossed boundaries until they became... that kind of relationship...♥
His ideal woman is his mom.
